steps.text: 0:00 A.M. \ Dusty
Downtown Lungmen, Busy Street

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: Hey, you're doing the whole 'triad face' thing again, you know?

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: ...Welcome back. Did you look into those people for me?

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: I came up with a rough sketch. As much as I'd like to bring these evildoers to justice, it looks like it's not going to be a one woman job.

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: I may have to ask for help at the office.

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: Seems they're not your run of the mill punks. And that Aak wasn't exactly forthcoming. He has to go and make everything so complicated...

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: I'm sorry, who?

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: Aak.

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: Ah?

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: ...His name is Aak.

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: Oh... Okay, well, since it's not so simple,

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: I'll help out.

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: ...You were listening, weren't you? A bunch of street thugs is one thing, but if we're dealing with a large-scale organized syndicate, we can't just go in there and start throwing punches.

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: We have other options besides going in there and starting to throw punches, don't we?

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: Are you really going to nail me on semantics?

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: I'm not joking.

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: ...Is Uncle Tung okay?

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: He wasn't hurt badly. But that's not the point.

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: Right. It's not. If this were just some underworld spat, I wouldn't get involved.

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: But when I see the wicked strike the innocent before my very eyes, I can't sit idly by and let them run amok.

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: ...Thanks. You've earned some finballs. On me.

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: I don't need finballs...

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: By the way,

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: This business tonight has something to do with Penguin Logistics. They're not even trying to cover up their involvement.

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: They're good people. They probably just got mixed up in it somehow.

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: They've gotten 'mixed up in things somehow' dozens of times this year alone. They need to be a little more careful, and stop making trouble for everyone.

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: If we run into them, we'll have to give them a warning.

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: Sand Originium Arts. Hmph.

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: Guess the freak running Lungmen's underworld had to have some teeth to him.

steps.name: Mafioso
steps.text: Mr. Capone, you don't mean...?

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: He ain't the kinda guy you wanna piss off, capiche?

steps.name: Mafioso
steps.text: The Rat King? But we're facing off against the boss, Penguin Logistics, and...

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: And half of Lungmen. Yeah, the outlook ain't so rosy. No room for mistakes.

steps.name: Mafioso
steps.text: What're you doing, Mr. Capone? Put down the crossbow!

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: You thought going against the Family would be easy?

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: I remember the face of every last man who agreed to follow me to Lungmen, who's ready to betray Gambino for the sake of survival.

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: And you ain't one of 'em. Take a dirt nap, Gambino dog.

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: Get outta here.

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: Here I thought you were just an ungrateful cazzo. Now I see you learned to buy and sell men.

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: Who do you think taught me?

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: Sure as hell wasn't me.

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: You earned my loyalty. Then you let me down harder than anything ever has. I won't make that same mistake.

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: You know what betrayal means, don't you?

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: It's Siracusa's greatest crime. But too bad for you, your honor and glory ain't worth shit in Lungmen.

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: Take it.

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: ...the Jack of Spades?

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: I told you. You deal too slow!

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: You're even slower with that sword, Gambino. You get hurt in your fight with the Penguins? Or are we openin' old wounds?

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: Seeing you turn coward like this makes me sick. I'm stuck thinkin' about how I should kill a traitor like you.

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: You're the Joker here now.

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: What's next? What're you gonna do? You take out Penguin Logistics? You take out the Rat King? You take out the LGD? You take out Wei Yenwu?

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: You're dreaming. Why not fall asleep forever?

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: Don't worry, I'll send your ashes back to Siracusa. Maybe I'll have the old village grind your corpse up.

steps.name: Mafioso A
steps.text: Woah, what're you...?!

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: ...What?

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: Sounds like we got party crashers.

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: ...I shoulda killed you quicker. But now we gotta play host.

steps.name: Mafioso A
steps.text: Stop 'em! Aagh! My toe...

steps.name: Mafioso B
steps.text: What's this, kung fu?! Can't even touch her!

steps.name: Mafioso A
steps.text: They're unarmed, just get 'em... Oof!

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: ...Phew.

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: So, it's you two?

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: I don't like to go around pickin' on weak little ladies, but...

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: You tore through my boys, walked right up to me, and you don't got a speck of dust on those pretty clothes of yours.

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: You the Rat King's people?

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: ...Were you in the slums?

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: You broke up a fight between Sicilians and you got the balls to ask questions?

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: ...Yeah. I'd say it was you two.

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: This mook, argh——!

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: Are you just going to watch?

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: Don't get me wrong. It's always a good idea to borrow a knife to off somebody, but I gotta deal with this cazzo myself.

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: On the other hand... You look like you're a handful.

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: I think you should surrender. Really.

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: Hah!

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: You're about as good as that wolf. Who knew the Rat King had cards like you up his sleeve!

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: What cards? What are you talking about? Just get down on the floor and turn yourself in!

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: Nng!

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: Hey, I remember you. I met you before. You dressed up like a seafood salesman. Played like you were making finballs.

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: Funny. I never thought I'd have to give you a second look.

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: No, I really am a... never mind.

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: Right now, just for tonight, I am what you think I am.

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: Hai-yah!

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: Hmph!

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: You gettin' beat by a girl over there, Gambino.

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: Oh I'm still gonna kill you. Wipe that smile off your face.

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: ...You've been looking for chances to take a low blow, dirty fighter.

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: How can you hope to win if you strike with the wrong part of your fist?

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: You will pay for the harm you have done.

steps.name: Uncle Tung
steps.text: ...You had me wait so long just to bring me here?

steps.name: Uncle Tung
steps.text: What is this about? Are we looking at grave plots? You want to be my neighbor even in death?

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: After so many years in business, how do you keep such a sharp tongue?

steps.name: Uncle Tung
steps.text: I don't talk to my customers like this. But you're not a customer.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: I'm hurt.

steps.name: Uncle Tung
steps.text: ...This is Ah Faat's grave. You probably don't know him.

steps.name: Uncle Tung
steps.text: This one's Rascally Chan's, and over here is Fake Yama.

steps.name: Uncle Tung
steps.text: Then in the back is Old Wu and the Steel Psycho, plus Lucky On. Lucky On's family was rich, so he got the hillside plot.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: So many.

steps.name: Uncle Tung
steps.text: At least they're all neighbors. We should think about where we'll stay too.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: I think it's still too early for that. Or are you trying to tell me you've got some terminal illness?

steps.name: Uncle Tung
steps.text: It's not early. We don't live long enough, so it always feels like we've been through tough times.

steps.name: Uncle Tung
steps.text: Like me. Our brothers gave their lives for us. But now that I've settled down, I look back and reflect on my life...

steps.name: Uncle Tung
steps.text: And nothing seems like that big a deal anymore. If there was anything really that big, I wouldn't be able to enjoy a peaceful life.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: Oh my. Did selling finballs bring you such enlightenment?

steps.name: Uncle Tung
steps.text: Honestly, food price inflation is a lot more dangerous to me than the mob.

steps.name: Uncle Tung
steps.text: ...Dai Lo, won't you be my neighbor here? The Feng Shui is excellent, and I hear you get a better deal buying the plots in pairs.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: Are you done?

steps.name: Uncle Tung
steps.text: I'm joking. It's a joke. Aiya. At least you have a daughter. I'm going to die alone.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: You have all the kids in the slums with you, don't you? And that Ah Fil boy.

steps.name: Uncle Tung
steps.text: But there's no blood. It makes a difference when you get old.

steps.name: Uncle Tung
steps.text: ...So you have to outlive me, a bit. Not too much. Just a bit. I'll wait for you down there.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: Are you always looking for ways to needle me?

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: By the way, I'm meeting an old friend later tonight. Would you like to join us for a drink?

steps.name: Uncle Tung
steps.text: No thanks. I'm worried Ah Fil is off getting himself into trouble. I'd better look into it.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: I'll look into it for you.

steps.name: Uncle Tung
steps.text: And how many old friends do I have left? I think they're all down there.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: You have one.

steps.name: Uncle Tung
steps.text: I can't talk with the one called Wei. I've been dealing with him a long time. It would be very short-lived.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: But you took a bullet for Wei Yenwu. It's why you can't walk straight anymore.

steps.name: Uncle Tung
steps.text: You think I don't know? Feh, I don't want to talk about this. It always makes me feel wretched.

steps.name: Uncle Tung
steps.text: ...But at least Lungmen can walk straight. At least she's not wretched.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: You're the same as you ever were. And I guess that's a good thing.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: If you've really seen enough of him, then you better be on your way.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: And even if he did see you, he probably wouldn't know what to say.

steps.name: Uncle Tung
steps.text: You finally let me go, Lin, this poor old wounded man.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: Mr. Tung.

steps.name: Uncle Tung
steps.text: What's that?

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: Live a while longer. Sell some more finballs.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: Buy yourself a building, open a restaurant, take a few apprentices, and then maybe think about where to put your coffin. There's no rush.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: The Rat King still lives. It's not your turn to die yet.

steps.name: Uncle Tung
steps.text: ...fine.
